hetch-hetchy.line: It starts 223 km east of the county line, at O'Shaughnessy Dam: 190 km of aqueduct, 63,118 acres of watershed across 4 counties, 11 reservoirs. All of it published. None of it in this frame.
hetch-hetchy.caveat: This named feature ENDS AT MOCCASIN (longitude -120.2653), not at Hetch Hetchy Reservoir (-119.789). It is 190.00 km — about 118 miles — of the system the city calls its 150-mile aqueduct. The upper Mountain Tunnel reach is not part of the named feature, so a label reading '150 miles' beside this line would be describing a different object.
